title: Minimize Product Sum of Two Arrays
summary: Calculate the minimum product sum of two arrays by rearranging the elements of one array.
statement: Calculate the minimum product sum of two arrays by rearranging the elements of one array. The product sum is defined as the sum of the element-wise products of two arrays. Given arrays nums1 and nums2 of equal length, find the minimum product sum by optimally rearranging nums1.
constraints: The arrays have equal length from 1 through 100000.
Rearrange either array to minimize the sum of corresponding products.
hints: A large value should be paired with a small value to avoid a large product.
Sort one array ascending and the other descending, then multiply aligned values.
If two pairs are similarly ordered, swapping their partners never increases the sum; repeatedly removing inversions yields the opposite-order optimum.
editorial: If two pairs are similarly ordered, swapping their partners never increases the sum; repeatedly removing inversions yields the opposite-order optimum.

tests.explanation: Pairing [2,3,4,5] with [5,4,2,2] gives the minimum sum forty.
Pairing opposite sorted orders yields sixty-five.
